title: Gap Fill by Gap Size
summary: The gap-fill rate split by gap-size bucket: xs under 0.15% of prior close, s 0.15-0.3%, m 0.3-0.75%, l 0.75-1.5%, xl at or above 1.5%. Each bucket's denominator is the gapped sessions whose absolute gap landed in that band (roll days excluded); the numerator is the ones that traded back to the prior close. The folklore says fill rates fall as gaps grow — the per-bucket intervals let you check whether your market and your sample actually show that, and by how much.
deltas: the buckets are a default view — absGapPct filters give any continuous cut of the same data
per-bucket N and 95% CI instead of one blended fill rate
time-to-fill distribution attached to every run
